data.content_ref: inline:COMPATIBLE WITH: the census-delta investigation (SRC_004/SRC_005) is compatible with the routing-rot test (SRC_003) because both share a mechanism — the falsification instrument (verify_root_report for the census, resolve_conjecture_route/compile_criticism_assignments for routing) is untested infrastructure whose silent failure hides evidence from operators. Integrating them means testing all verification-instrument callables in a single suite. Refuted if verify_root_report is already transitively tested by the same integration path that covers the routing functions, making the shared untested-instrument claim false.
